title: Zesty Ethiopian Steak Atakilt Wat
description: A zesty, keto-friendly Ethiopian stew with lean minced steak, fresh veggies, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the comal over medium-high heat and add 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Sauté 1 medium diced onion until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add 2 cloves minced garlic and 1 tablespoon grated ginger, cooking until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Stir in 200g lean ground beef, breaking it apart with a spatula until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.

Add 1 medium julienned carrot, 1 medium julienned zucchini, 2 tablespoons Ethiopian spice blend, 1 tablespoon lemon zest and 2 tablespoons lemon juice, cooking until vegetables soften, about 4 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, ensuring internal temperature reaches 71 C.
Transfer the stew to a serving dish and garnish with 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro.
Serve hot directly from the comal, enjoying the zesty flavors.
